init.title: Bluetooth handheld
init.description: Choose the firmware type and enter its Home Assistant Bluetooth address. For stock ARM, also enter the first six bytes of the SwitchBot manufacturer data for the same device. The Almost Universal handheld profile uses Bluetooth only.

error.invalid_address: Enter this handheld's Bluetooth address as shown by Home Assistant.
error.invalid_manufacturer_id: Enter the first six bytes as 12 hexadecimal digits.

user.title: Set up The Ununiversal Remote
user.description: Optionally choose a switch for soft key A. Open Remote Menus after setup to edit the menu.

error.invalid_remote_id: Use lowercase letters, digits, or underscores, starting with a letter (up to 32 characters).

abort.already_configured: The remote integration is already set up.
